# Columns of the `m.options` datasets

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

Each section lists one dataset's columns in the order every verb returns them. **Supplied by** names the transports that fill a column; a column the serving transport does not fill is null. The wire-field columns name the Massive fields behind each column (`request` for a value the library fills from the request). The same descriptions appear in the web UI's column tooltips and in a query's `columns()`.

<a id="trades"></a>

## `m.options.trades`

Trades of US-listed options contracts (OPRA), tick by tick.

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by | REST field | Flat-file field | WebSocket field |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. REST `T`: "The exchange symbol that this item is traded under." REST: the request's `optionsTicker` parameter. FLAT_FILES `ticker`: "The exchange symbol that this item is traded under." WS `sym`: "The ticker symbol for the given option contract." | REST, flat files, WebSocket | `T`, request | `ticker` | `sym` |
| `Timestamp` | Instant | The row's primary time, as an Instant. REST `t`: "The nanosecond accuracy SIP Unix Timestamp. This is the timestamp of when the SIP received this message from the exchange which produced it." REST `sip_timestamp`: "The nanosecond accuracy SIP Unix Timestamp. This is the timestamp of when the SIP received this trade from the exchange which produced it." FLAT_FILES `sip_timestamp`: "The nanosecond accuracy SIP Unix Timestamp. This is the timestamp of when the SIP received this trade from the exchange which produced it." WS `t`: "The Timestamp in Unix MS." | REST, flat files, WebSocket | `t`, `sip_timestamp` | `sip_timestamp` | `t` |
| `Conditions` | int[] | A list of condition codes. See Options Condition Codes (https://massive.com/docs/rest/options/market-operations/condition-codes) for what each code means. | REST, flat files, WebSocket | `c`, `conditions` | `conditions` | `c` |
| `Correction` | long | The trade correction indicator. | REST, flat files | `e`, `correction` | `correction` |  |
| `Exchange` | long | The exchange ID. See Exchanges (https://massive.com/docs/rest/options/market-operations/exchanges) for Massive's mapping of exchange IDs. | REST, flat files, WebSocket | `x`, `exchange` | `exchange` | `x` |
| `Id` | String | The trade ID. Options trades do not have a trade ID, so this field is returned as an empty string. | REST | `i`, `id` |  |  |
| `ParticipantTimestamp` | Instant | The nanosecond accuracy Participant/Exchange Unix Timestamp. This is the timestamp of when the trade was actually generated at the exchange. | REST | `y`, `participant_timestamp` |  |  |
| `Price` | double | The price of the trade. This is the price per share of the underlying, so the total dollar value of a trade is the price multiplied by the size and by the contract multiplier, which is typically 100 shares per contract. | REST, flat files, WebSocket | `p`, `price` | `price` | `p` |
| `SequenceNumber` | long | The sequence number represents the sequence in which message events happened. These are increasing and unique per ticker symbol, but will not always be sequential (e.g., 1, 2, 6, 9, 10, 11). | REST, WebSocket | `q`, `sequence_number` |  | `q` |
| `Size` | double | The size of a trade (also known as volume). | REST, flat files, WebSocket | `s`, `size` | `size` | `s` |
| `Tape` | long | There are 3 tapes which define which exchange the ticker is listed on. These are integers in our objects which represent the letter of the alphabet. Eg: 1 = A, 2 = B, 3 = C. * Tape A is NYSE listed securities * Tape B is NYSE ARCA / NYSE American * Tape C is NASDAQ | REST | `z` |  |  |
| `TrfId` | long | The ID for the Trade Reporting Facility where the trade took place. | REST | `r` |  |  |
| `TrfTimestamp` | Instant | The nanosecond accuracy TRF(Trade Reporting Facility) Unix Timestamp. This is the timestamp of when the trade reporting facility received this message. | REST | `f` |  |  |
| `DecimalSize` | String | Always null for `options.trades`; supplied by `stocks.trades`. |  |  |  |  |
| `ReportSequence` | long | Always null for `options.trades`; supplied by `futures.trades`. |  |  |  |  |
| `SessionEndDate` | LocalDate | Always null for `options.trades`; supplied by `futures.trades`. |  |  |  |  |
| `Channel` | long | Always null for `options.trades`; supplied by `futures.trades`. |  |  |  |  |
| `ReceivedTimestamp` | Instant | Always null for `options.trades`; supplied by `crypto.trades`. |  |  |  |  |

<a id="fmv"></a>

## `m.options.fmv`

Massive's fair market value of US-listed options contracts, streamed in real time.

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by | WebSocket field |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. WS `sym`: "The ticker symbol for the given security." | WebSocket | `sym` |
| `Timestamp` | Instant | The row's primary time, as an Instant. WS `t`: "The nanosecond timestamp." | WebSocket | `t` |
| `Fmv` | double | Fair market value is only available on Business plans. It is our proprietary algorithm to generate a real-time, accurate, fair market value of a tradable security. For more information, contact us (https://massive.com/contact). | WebSocket | `fmv` |

<a id="chain"></a>

## `m.options.chain`

The snapshot of every contract in one underlying's option chain.

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by | REST field |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. REST `details.ticker`: "The ticker symbol for the asset." | REST | `details.ticker` |
| `BreakEvenPrice` | double | The price of the underlying asset for the contract to break even. For a call, this value is (strike price + premium paid). For a put, this value is (strike price - premium paid). | REST | `break_even_price` |
| `DayChange` | double | The value of the price change for the contract from the previous trading day. | REST | `day.change` |
| `DayChangePercent` | double | The percent of the price change for the contract from the previous trading day. | REST | `day.change_percent` |
| `DayClose` | double | The closing price for the contract of the day. | REST | `day.close` |
| `DayHigh` | double | The highest price for the contract of the day. | REST | `day.high` |
| `DayLastUpdated` | Instant | The nanosecond timestamp of when this information was updated. | REST | `day.last_updated` |
| `DayLow` | double | The lowest price for the contract of the day. | REST | `day.low` |
| `DayOpen` | double | The open price for the contract of the day. | REST | `day.open` |
| `DayPreviousClose` | double | The closing price for the contract of previous trading day. | REST | `day.previous_close` |
| `DayVolume` | double | The trading volume for the contract of the day. | REST | `day.volume` |
| `DayVwap` | double | The trading volume weighted average price for the contract of the day. | REST | `day.vwap` |
| `DetailsContractType` | String | The type of contract. Can be "put", "call", or in some rare cases, "other". | REST | `details.contract_type` |
| `DetailsExerciseStyle` | String | The exercise style of this contract. See this link (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Option_style) for more details on exercise styles. | REST | `details.exercise_style` |
| `DetailsExpirationDate` | LocalDate | The contract's expiration date in YYYY-MM-DD format. | REST | `details.expiration_date` |
| `DetailsSharesPerContract` | double | The number of shares per contract for this contract. | REST | `details.shares_per_contract` |
| `DetailsStrikePrice` | double | The strike price of the option contract. | REST | `details.strike_price` |
| `Fmv` | double | Fair Market Value is only available on Business plans. It is our proprietary algorithm to generate a real-time, accurate, fair market value of a tradable security. For more information, contact us (https://massive.com/contact). | REST | `fmv` |
| `FmvLastUpdated` | Instant | If Fair Market Value (FMV) is available, this field is the nanosecond timestamp of the last FMV calculation. | REST | `fmv_last_updated` |
| `GreeksDelta` | double | The change in the option's price per $0.01 increment in the price of the underlying asset. | REST | `greeks.delta` |
| `GreeksGamma` | double | The change in delta per $0.01 change in the price of the underlying asset. | REST | `greeks.gamma` |
| `GreeksTheta` | double | The change in the option's price per day. | REST | `greeks.theta` |
| `GreeksVega` | double | The change in the option's price per 1% increment in volatility. | REST | `greeks.vega` |
| `ImpliedVolatility` | double | The market's forecast for the volatility of the underlying asset, based on this option's current price. | REST | `implied_volatility` |
| `LastQuoteAsk` | double | The ask price. | REST | `last_quote.ask` |
| `LastQuoteAskExchange` | double | The ask side exchange ID. See Exchanges (https://massive.com/docs/rest/options/market-operations/exchanges) for Massive's mapping of exchange IDs. | REST | `last_quote.ask_exchange` |
| `LastQuoteAskSize` | double | The ask size. | REST | `last_quote.ask_size` |
| `LastQuoteBid` | double | The bid price. | REST | `last_quote.bid` |
| `LastQuoteBidExchange` | double | The bid side exchange ID. See Exchanges (https://massive.com/docs/rest/options/market-operations/exchanges) for Massive's mapping of exchange IDs. | REST | `last_quote.bid_exchange` |
| `LastQuoteBidSize` | double | The bid size. | REST | `last_quote.bid_size` |
| `LastQuoteLastUpdated` | Instant | The nanosecond timestamp of when this information was updated. | REST | `last_quote.last_updated` |
| `LastQuoteMidpoint` | double | The average of the bid and ask price. | REST | `last_quote.midpoint` |
| `LastQuoteTimeframe` | String | The time relevance of the data. | REST | `last_quote.timeframe` |
| `LastTradeConditions` | int[] | A list of condition codes. See Options Condition Codes (https://massive.com/docs/rest/options/market-operations/condition-codes) for what each code means. | REST | `last_trade.conditions` |
| `LastTradeExchange` | long | The exchange ID. See Exchanges (https://massive.com/docs/rest/options/market-operations/exchanges) for Massive's mapping of exchange IDs. | REST | `last_trade.exchange` |
| `LastTradePrice` | double | The price of the trade. This is the price per share of the underlying, so the total dollar value of a trade is the price multiplied by the size and by the contract multiplier, which is typically 100 shares per contract. | REST | `last_trade.price` |
| `LastTradeSipTimestamp` | Instant | The nanosecond accuracy SIP Unix Timestamp. This is the timestamp of when the SIP received this trade from the exchange which produced it. | REST | `last_trade.sip_timestamp` |
| `LastTradeSize` | long | The size of a trade (also known as volume). | REST | `last_trade.size` |
| `LastTradeTimeframe` | String | The time relevance of the data. | REST | `last_trade.timeframe` |
| `OpenInterest` | double | The quantity of this contract held at the end of the last trading day. | REST | `open_interest` |
| `UnderlyingAssetChangeToBreakEven` | double | The change in price for the contract to break even. | REST | `underlying_asset.change_to_break_even` |
| `UnderlyingAssetLastUpdated` | Instant | The nanosecond timestamp of when this information was updated. | REST | `underlying_asset.last_updated` |
| `UnderlyingAssetPrice` | double | The price of the trade. This is the actual dollar value per whole share of this trade. A trade of 100 shares with a price of $2.00 would be worth a total dollar value of $200.00. | REST | `underlying_asset.price` |
| `Underlying` | String | The underlying instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. REST `underlying_asset.ticker`: "The ticker symbol for the contract's underlying asset." | REST | `underlying_asset.ticker` |
| `UnderlyingAssetTimeframe` | String | The time relevance of the data. | REST | `underlying_asset.timeframe` |
| `UnderlyingAssetValue` | double | The value of the underlying index. | REST | `underlying_asset.value` |

| `SessionEarlyTradingChangePercent` | double | Today's early trading change as a percentage. | REST | `session.early_trading_change_percent` |
| `SessionHigh` | double | The highest price of the asset for the day. | REST | `session.high` |
| `SessionLateTradingChange` | double | Today's late trading change amount, difference between price and today's close if in late trading hours, otherwise difference between last price during late trading and today's close. | REST | `session.late_trading_change` |
| `SessionLateTradingChangePercent` | double | Today's late trading change as a percentage. | REST | `session.late_trading_change_percent` |
| `SessionLow` | double | The lowest price of the asset for the day. | REST | `session.low` |
| `SessionOpen` | double | The open price of the asset for the day. | REST | `session.open` |
| `SessionPreviousClose` | double | The closing price of the asset for the previous trading day. This is the correct field for the prior session's reference price, and it is retained across the daily session rollover. It is absent only for an asset with no completed prior session, such as a newly listed ticker or option contract. | REST | `session.previous_close` |
| `SessionPrice` | double | The price of the most recent trade or bid price for this asset. | REST | `session.price` |
| `SessionRegularTradingChange` | double | Today's change in regular trading hours, difference between current price and previous trading day's close, otherwise difference between today's close and previous day's close. | REST | `session.regular_trading_change` |
| `SessionRegularTradingChangePercent` | double | Today's regular trading change as a percentage. | REST | `session.regular_trading_change_percent` |
| `SessionVolume` | double | The trading volume for the asset for the day. A value of 0 means no trades have occurred yet in the current session. | REST | `session.volume` |
| `Timeframe` | String | The time relevance of the data. | REST | `timeframe` |
| `Type` | String | The asset class for this ticker. | REST | `type` |
| `UnderlyingAssetChangeToBreakEven` | double | The change in price for the contract to break even. | REST | `underlying_asset.change_to_break_even` |
| `UnderlyingAssetLastUpdated` | Instant | The nanosecond timestamp of when this information was updated. | REST | `underlying_asset.last_updated` |
| `UnderlyingAssetPrice` | double | The price of the trade. This is the actual dollar value per whole share of this trade. A trade of 100 shares with a price of $2.00 would be worth a total dollar value of $200.00. | REST | `underlying_asset.price` |
| `Underlying` | String | The underlying instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. REST `underlying_asset.ticker`: "The ticker symbol for the contract's underlying asset." | REST | `underlying_asset.ticker` |
| `UnderlyingAssetTimeframe` | String | The time relevance of the data. | REST | `underlying_asset.timeframe` |
| `UnderlyingAssetValue` | double | The value of the underlying index. | REST | `underlying_asset.value` |
| `Value` | double | Value of Index. | REST | `value` |

<a id="contracts"></a>

## `m.options.contracts`

Reference data on options contracts: type, exercise style, expiration, and strike.

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by | REST field |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. REST `ticker`: "The ticker for the option contract." | REST | `ticker` |
| `AdditionalUnderlyings` | String | If an option contract has additional underlyings or deliverables associated with it, they will appear here. See here (https://www.optionseducation.org/referencelibrary/faq/splits-mergers-spinoffs-bankruptcies) for some examples of what might cause a contract to have additional underlyings. | REST | `additional_underlyings` |
| `Cfi` | String | The 6 letter CFI code of the contract (defined in ISO 10962 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_10962)) | REST | `cfi` |
| `ContractType` | String | The type of contract. Can be "put", "call", or in some rare cases, "other". | REST | `contract_type` |
| `Correction` | long | The correction number for this option contract. | REST | `correction` |
| `ExerciseStyle` | String | The exercise style of this contract. See this link (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Option_style) for more details on exercise styles. | REST | `exercise_style` |
| `ExpirationDate` | LocalDate | The contract's expiration date in YYYY-MM-DD format. | REST | `expiration_date` |
| `PrimaryExchange` | String | The MIC code of the primary exchange that this contract is listed on. | REST | `primary_exchange` |
| `SharesPerContract` | double | The number of shares per contract for this contract. | REST | `shares_per_contract` |
| `StrikePrice` | double | The strike price of the option contract. | REST | `strike_price` |
| `Underlying` | String | The underlying instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. REST `underlying_ticker`: "The underlying ticker that the option contract relates to." | REST | `underlying_ticker` |

<a id="daily_open_close"></a>

## `m.options.daily_open_close`

The open, high, low, close, and volume of each options contract on one day.

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by | REST field |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. REST `symbol`: "The exchange symbol that this item is traded under." | REST | `symbol` |
| `AfterHours` | double | The close price of the ticker symbol in after hours trading. | REST | `afterHours` |
| `Close` | double | The close price for the symbol in the given time period. | REST | `close` |
| `From` | LocalDate | The requested date. | REST | `from` |
| `High` | double | The highest price for the symbol in the given time period. | REST | `high` |
| `Low` | double | The lowest price for the symbol in the given time period. | REST | `low` |
| `Open` | double | The open price for the symbol in the given time period. | REST | `open` |
| `Otc` | boolean | Whether or not this aggregate is for an OTC ticker. This field will be left off if false. | REST | `otc` |
| `PreMarket` | double | The open price of the ticker symbol in pre-market trading. | REST | `preMarket` |
| `Volume` | double | The trading volume of the symbol in the given time period. | REST | `volume` |
